fields.objection: 042 precedents use different materials, gauges, supports, sizes and shape metrics. Its 0.15 mm reflector-class peak is a three-sigma projection.
fields.proposed_fix: Demonstrate the full formed Be blank, bond and in-place seam; measure both local and global shape before treating a precedent as an achievable hull tolerance.
